Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Timothy Wallace (E022)
- Role: Engineer
- Employment type: contractor
- Security training: basic

Requested: admin access to Payroll.

Policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

Timothy is a contractor. Contractors can never have admin. Write requires advanced security training; he has basic, so maximum is read.

Requested admin > maximum read, so grant maximum = read.

Decision: read.
